insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 37% men's. Alo skews 53% women's, Gymshark 21% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +9% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (155) vs Lululemon (125). Vuori leads by 30.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 46% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1385 vs 1023 products. A 35% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 613 products. Behind Gymshark (1082).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 501 products vs Lululemon's 420. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 29,403 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 3,695 = 11% share of tracked catalog.
